name: polylog
description: One git log across every repository in your workspace. Search commit messages, filter by author, branch and date across all of them at once, and open any change in the native diff editor.

polylog.pageSize.description: Commits fetched per repository per page.

polylog.maxConcurrency.description: Maximum number of git processes running at once.

polylog.scanDepth.markdownDescription: Folder levels to search the workspace folders for repositories. Polylog shows these together with the repositories the Git extension has open. See also `#git.repositoryScanMaxDepth#`.

polylog.excludeRepos.description: Glob patterns for repositories to leave out, matched against the repository folder name and its full path.
